MountainSort 5 (Flatiron Institute): isosplit clustering, published defaults

```text
dspk sort mountainsort5 [OPTIONS] --output <OUTPUT> <RECORDING>
```

**Arguments**

- **`<RECORDING>`**  
  Recording (SpikeGLX .bin / .cbin, raw .bin + JSON .meta, NWB, Zarr)

**Settings**

- **`--source <SOURCE>`**  
  Source within the file (an id `dspk-cli open` lists); default: the largest electrical one
- **`--probe <PROBE>`**: one of `neuropixels1`, `neuropixels2`, `tetrode`, `utah`, `hdemg4x8`, `hdemg8x8`  
  Probe preset; default: the geometry the recording carries (SpikeGLX), else an error
- **`--probe-file <PROBE_FILE>`**  
  Probe file (.json: probeinterface or Kilosort 4) saying which channel each contact is wired to: the data is read in contact order (unconnected contacts left out), with its geometry
- **`--progress <PROGRESS>`**: default `bar`, one of `bar`, `json`  
  How progress is reported: `bar` (on stderr) or `json` (one JSON object per line on stdout: `progress` events, then `done` or `error`; for programs running this one)
- **`--channel-map <CHANNEL_MAP>`**  
  Channel map (.toml / .json, pairs under `remap`) applied after the probe: channels reordered, dropped, renamed; the geometry follows them
- **`--pitch-um <PITCH_UM>`**: default `8000`  
  Electrode pitch of HD-EMG grid presets (µm)
- **`--start-sec <START_SEC>`**: default `0`  
  Start of the part to process (s)
- **`--duration-sec <DURATION_SEC>`**  
  Length of the part to process (s); default: to the end
- **`-o, --output <OUTPUT>`**  
  Output folder or store
- **`--format <FORMAT>`**  
  Output format; default: from the name (`.nwb.zarr` → nwb, other `.zarr` → zarr, else phy)
  - `phy`: Phy / Kilosort folder (`.npy` arrays, `.tsv` tables)
  - `zarr`: dspk `.sorting.zarr` store
  - `nwb`: NWB `/units` table in a `.nwb.zarr` store
- **`--show-config`**  
  Print every setting of the run and exit
